results.content: # Big Five Personality Test. This free personality test gives you accurate scores for the Big Five personality traits. The Big Five describes personality traits along five common dimensions: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism. ## What is the Big Five Personality Test? When you take a Big Five test, you will receive scores for five dimensions of personality:. This makes the Big Five model distinct from many pop psychology systems that classify people in terms of personality "types." In a Big Five test, rather than being sorted into types, people are described in terms of how they compare with the average across each of the five personality traits. ## Big Five Personality Test FAQ. What is the Big Five personality test based on? **A.** The Big Five personality test is a comprehensive personality inventory based on decades of psychological research. results.title: Personality
results.content: 5. Unlike temperament, personality refers to the integrative function of human behavior. The terms personality and temperament are both used in the literature to refer to temporary and relatively stable individual differences in behavior. *"...whereas personality items refer mainly to the fequency criterion (how often a given behavior occurs), temperament items mostly have to do with the intensity measure [how strong (intense) a given reaction (behavior) is expressed]"* (p.198). Van Heck (1991) referred to temperament as *"those traits or mechanisms which (1) form the biological basis of personality, (2) reflect style rather than content of behavior, and (3) have a high heritability"* (p.165). Citing the 1980 temperament Research Symposium in New Haven, McCall (1986) notes that temperament *"involves those dimensions of personality that are largely genetic or constitutional in origin, exist in most ages and most societies, show some consistency across situations, and are relatively stable, at least with major development areas"* (p.17).
